title: 7.14 Review: a busy day
unit_title: Everyday needs, plans and free time
unit_outcome: Say what hurts and why someone feels a certain way, describe what people are wearing and the weather as it happens, tell someone to put on or take off clothes, talk about what people like doing, invite and answer, ask someone to repeat or explain, talk about being sick, the months and seasons, compare with the biggest and the tallest, and say what people and animals can do and are good at.
goal: Review every A1+ Unit 7 step with new people: what hurts, why, what people are wearing, the weather now, putting clothes on, likes + -ing, polite invitations and repair, being sick, the seasons, the -est, can and good at, with no new language.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 7.14 Three Everyday Situations: A1 reviews Unit 7 in fresh situations; A1+ 7.14 reviews every A1+ Unit 7 step with twelve fresh photos of new people and no new language: His arms hurt. and What's wrong with him? (7.1), Why …? Because … (7.2), wearing (7.3), It's raining. (7.4), putting on (7.5), likes + -ing (7.6), Would you like to …? (7.7), Could you speak slowly, please? (7.8), has a cough and feels sick (7.9), in summer (7.10), the biggest and the smallest (7.11), can (7.12) and good at (7.13). Nobody in the photos speaks in the first person (the cast's voices belong to the cast), so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers.
speaking_outcome: Say what is wrong, what people wear and like, the weather, invitations and requests, and what people and animals can do, with every Unit 7 form, at a natural pace.
